extension.name: MiFoto
extension.author: ChasKa
extension.license: GNU/GPL v3 or any later version
extension.description: Profile photos for Joomla 5 and 6: safe upload, WebP conversion and per-group permissions. After installing, enable the plugins "User - MiFoto" (profile form), "Content - MiFoto" ({user} tag) and, if you use Akeeba Engage, "Engage - MiFoto"; then set the MiFoto permissions.
